fix: Compare through borrows inside the comparator so no Option<FocusOrder> (String clone for lexical orders) is built per comparison: nodes.sort_by(|left, right| { let left = left.state.traversal_order.borrow(); let right = right.state.traversal_order.borrow(); match (left.as_ref(), right.as_ref()) { (Some(left), Some(right)) => left.compare(right), (Some(_), None) => std::cmp::Ordering::Less, (None, Some(_)) => std::cmp::Ordering::Greater, (None, None) => std::cmp::Ordering::Equal } });

Filter lazily instead of collecting every traversable node to take one: fn is_traversable(node: &FocusNode) -> bool { node.can_request_focus() && !node.skip_traversal() } (module-private helper, also used by traversable()). find_first_focus: nodes.iter().find(|node| is_traversable(node)).cloned(); find_last_focus (line 1115): nodes.iter().rfind(|node| is_traversable(node)).cloned().

WidgetOrderTraversalPolicy::next and previous (and the Tab path through FocusScopeNode::focus_next) allocate a Vec per key press. Walk the lazy filter instead: next = let mut eligible = nodes.iter().filter(|node| is_traversable(node)); if eligible.by_ref().any(|node| node == current) { eligible.next().cloned() } else { nodes.iter().find(|node| is_traversable(node)).cloned() }. previous = iterate the filter, return the cloned predecessor when node == current (None if current is first), and fall back to nodes.iter().filter(..).last().cloned() when current is absent.

Vec allocated on every iteration of the while loop (once per placed item), then sorted only to take its first element. Replace lines 719-733 with a single min search: let pick = (0..unplaced.len()).filter(|&index| overlaps_band(rect(&unplaced[index]), topmost)).min_by(|&left, &right| rect(&unplaced[left]).origin.x.partial_cmp(&rect(&unplaced[right]).origin.x).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)).unwrap_or(0); then sorted.push(unplaced.remove(pick)). Equivalent: topmost (index 0) is the only possible band member when the band is non-empty and has one member, and min_by returns the first minimum like the stable sort did.

Directional key press allocates an index Vec and fully sorts it only to read the first element. Replace the collect, sort_by and indices.first().copied() with: (0..candidates.len()).min_by(|&left, &right| key(left).partial_cmp(&key(right)).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)). min_by returns the first minimum, the same element a stable sort would place first.

directional_search allocates eligible (and a second shared Vec at line 878 that is collected and then assigned over eligible) on every arrow-key search, twice per call when wrapping. Replace the shared Vec with an in-place filter: if eligible.iter().any(|&index| candidates[index].shares_scroll_owner) { eligible.retain(|&index| candidates[index].shares_scroll_owner); }. To remove the remaining allocation, thread a caller-owned scratch Vec<usize> through directional_focus_index (its signature change would be a public API change recorded in the CHANGELOG).

focus_next_silent (Tab path) collects every live node into one Vec, then policy_nodes -> traversable() collects the traversable survivors into a second Vec. Filter once: let live: Vec<FocusNode> = ... keep only nodes passing is_traversable (or make policy_nodes accept the filtered iterator) so only one Vec is built per Tab press.
